scope: Seven unapproved draft questions from four quarantined sources compared locally with historical question wording; diagnostic only, no Gold or model answer generation
manualTopNeighborRead: The top three old-question wordings for each draft were read from the full local output. They concern existing product ports, PoE, model-document navigation or deployment fit, rather than the source-specific regional data, subscriber arithmetic, ETSI procedure or SD4ADDR results. The 5G-band draft's nearest neighbor asks whether a 2.5G Ethernet port means 5G cellular; the shared token does not make the requested fact equivalent.
limits: Cosine scores are not an independence threshold or acceptance verdict.
The comparison covers the 300-case corpus and 50 historical blind rows, not every development prompt, output, provider-side exposure or public model pretraining.
Source reuse, full visual review, product read/citation and question-level Gold approval remain separate gates.
